text: I need to get out of the heat with the kids for a bit
note: Expects the two shows with an approved 'indoor' attribute, plus Animal Care at Conservation Station (indoor, user-confirmed). Zootopia was removed because indoor wasn't confirmed.

text: Where can I get a sit-down lunch after the safari?
note: 'Tusker House Restaurant' maps to tusker-house. No other pack dining item in Africa is table service. Tusker House's attributes are 'buffet', 'character dining', 'reservations'; it has no 'table service' attribute.

text: Something calm with animals, not a ride
note: 'The four walking trails' maps to the four pack items of kind 'trail'. Jumping Junction (animal-habitat) also has 'walking' and 'animal viewing' but wasn't added.

text: A quick bite in Pandora, not a sit-down meal
note: 'Satu'li Canteen' maps to satuli-canteen, the only Pandora pack item with 'quick service'. Pongu Pongu (drinks, snack) is the only other Pandora dining item and wasn't added.

text: An indoor show, not a ride
note: Only pack shows with an approved 'indoor' attribute. Zootopia was removed because indoor wasn't confirmed.

text: Where do I find Countdown to Extinction?
